message: Relation field "A.bs" is an implicit many-to-many relation named "X", and so is relation field "C.ds"; Prisma 7 creates one table "_X" for them, wired to only one of the relations (its foreign keys show which). Give each relation its own name with @relation("<name>") on both fields: renaming a relation that "_X" does not reference makes Prisma 7's next migration create its own table, while renaming the one it references moves "_X"'s foreign keys to another relation, which fails on rows whose ids that relation's models lack and attaches the rest to the wrong records.

Relation field "C.ds" is an implicit many-to-many relation named "X", and so is relation field "A.bs"; Prisma 7 creates one table "_X" for them, wired to only one of the relations (its foreign keys show which). Give each relation its own name with @relation("<name>") on both fields: renaming a relation that "_X" does not reference makes Prisma 7's next migration create its own table, while renaming the one it references moves "_X"'s foreign keys to another relation, which fails on rows whose ids that relation's models lack and attaches the rest to the wrong records.
